data.name: Smokewagon Pitmaster: Idle BBQ
data.description_full:
Fire up the smoker and start your roadside BBQ adventure! In Smokewagon Pitmaster: Idle BBQ, you’ll run a cozy barbecue food truck on the highway, starting from a small camp-style stand and growing it into a famous Texas BBQ restaurant.

Use relaxing merge gameplay to research new dishes. Merge ingredients, sauces, tools, and BBQ recipes to unlock brisket, ribs, sausages, grilled chicken, side dishes, drinks, and more. Every new recipe brings more hungry travelers to your food truck.

Upgrade your smoker, kitchen, tables, service area, and campsite facilities. Hire helpers, serve faster, and keep your customers happy. As your restaurant grows, expand your roadside camp with string lights, tents, RVs, wooden tables, and rustic western decorations.

This is a relaxing merge restaurant game that combines American BBQ, road trip vibes, camping life, and food truck management. Perfect for players who enjoy cooking games, merge games, restaurant games, and idle tycoon games.

Start with an old food truck, discover more recipes, upgrade your facilities, serve more guests, and turn your roadside BBQ stand into the most popular barbecue camp on the highway!
data.description_short: Merge recipes, smoke tasty BBQ, and grow your roadside food truck camp!

data.name: Chameleon Game: Paint & Hide
data.description_full:
Chameleon: Paint Color & Hide is a colorful chameleon game all about camouflage — paint the chameleon, match the background, and hide in plain sight until it completely vanishes.

🦎 HIDE LIKE A CHAMELEON Your chameleon starts with a plain body. Tap a color, swipe to paint it, and match the background so perfectly that it disappears. The better you blend, the better you hide.

🎨 PAINT & MATCH THE COLORS Mix and match colors to camouflage against walls, objects, and every background. Fine-tune the shade for a perfect color match, then watch your chameleon vanish into the scene.

🕵️ CAMOUFLAGE CHALLENGE Every stage is a new camouflage challenge — part color puzzle, part stealth. Read the environment, pick the right colors, and disguise your chameleon so well it can't be spotted.

🌍 NEW STAGES & COLORS Unlock colorful new stages and environments, each with its own colors to crack. Simple to play, satisfying to master.

Paint, blend, hide, and vanish. Become the ultimate chameleon master of disguise in this relaxing hide-and-seek twist on camouflage!

✔ COLORING THERAPY FOR YOUR MIND
Color by number coloring is proven to calm anxiety and boost focus. A few minutes a day with Color Paint can replace stress with zen, silence, and mindful flow — real art therapy in your pocket.

data.name: ZombieTok: The Last Stream
data.description_full:
Welcome to ZombieTok: The Last Stream!

The Apocalypse is here. Zombies have taken the streets, the Wasteland expands, and dangerous Mutants roam the dark. There are no safe zones and no real audience—because you aren't just watching a Livestream, you are the main Streamer of this doomsday show.

ZombieTok: The Last Stream is a Zombie Apocalypse-themed 3D idle RPG. As a survivor and Streamer, assemble your hunter squad, start Livestream missions, and battle zombies, Mutants, and Wasteland bosses for Survival resources.

[Apocalyptic Livestream, Survival is Content]
In this Wasteland world, every deployment is a Livestream. The audience wants thrills, the Zombies want you dead, and your job is to lead your squad to complete quests, collect gear, upgrade weapons and armor, and create your own epic moments.

[3D Zombie Wasteland, Immersive RPG Experience]
Explore Zombie-infested cities, abandoned streets, and dangerous outposts. Face ordinary zombies, powerful Mutants, and doomsday bosses. Constantly improve character stats, gear strength, and team CP to tackle higher-difficulty PvE Wasteland stages.

[AFK Rewards & Auto-battle for Easy Growth]
Don't want to grind manually? No problem. The game supports Auto-battle and AFK rewards. Even when offline, you can continue gathering resources to help you level up characters, enhance gear, and boost CP. Go Online to claim your rewards and continue your Survival journey.

[Hunter Progression, Build Your Doomsday Squad]
Train multiple characters, each with unique roles and combat abilities. Build the perfect Survival squad through leveling, gear enhancement, stat boosts, and team composition.

[Build a Zombie Farm & Collect Resources]
Catch a Zombie to work for you! Give them a job and make them work overtime to generate endless AFK income! Upgrade your farm to gather even more resources.

[Doomsday Bounties & Cross-Server PvP]
Cooperate across the server to challenge Zombie bosses, and team up on your Livestream for massive rewards. The Apocalypse isn't a solo show—true elites prove themselves on the PvP leaderboards.

[Guild, Friends & Chat Social Features]
Join a Guild, make friends, and discuss team builds, events, and combat strategies in the global Chat. Participate in events with Guild members, challenge tough enemies, and build your own Survival alliance.

[Branching Storyline, The Truth Behind the Livestream]
A complete storyline with multiple branches and endless plot twists. You'll encounter survivors, enemies, Mutants, and the secrets hidden behind the Livestream. Every choice can change your fate.

Your Livestream has started. The Chat is spamming, the Zombies are closing in, and the Wasteland awaits a new survivor legend.

Enter ZombieTok: The Last Stream now! Start your doomsday Livestream, train your hunter squad, utilize AFK Auto-battle, join a Guild, and survive to the very end in both PvE and PvP battlefields!

Contact us: zombietok.ru@hotmail.com
data.description_short: Go live in a zombie wasteland, build your guild, and fight to survive.

data.name: Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
data.description_full:
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng là một trò chơi chiến lược quân sự trực tuyến độc đáo. Trò chơi mới này kết hợp chiến thuật quân sự, lối chơi casual và yếu tố mô phỏng, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn miễn phí và đầy kịch tính cho người hâm mộ game chiến tranh, RTS (Chiến lược thời gian thực) và chiến đấu quân sự.

Xây dựng Căn cứ
Trải nghiệm tính chân thực của chiến tranh hiện đại bằng cách xây dựng và nâng cấp các công sự quân sự, bao gồm tháp pháo phòng không, kho nhiên liệu và nhà máy thiết giáp. Tạo nên một pháo đài thép bất khả xâm phạm với sự cân bằng hoàn hảo giữa tấn công và phòng thủ. Quản lý chuỗi tài nguyên một cách chiến lược để tối đa hóa năng lực sản xuất chiến tranh, đảm bảo căn cứ của bạn sống sót sau những đợt pháo kích dữ dội trong các trận chiến thời gian thực.

Những Đội quân Huyền thoại
Chiêu mộ các vị tướng Thế chiến II huyền thoại như Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel và Zhukov, mỗi người sở hữu kỹ năng chiến thuật độc đáo và lộ trình nâng cấp cá nhân hóa. Kết hợp nhiều đơn vị quân đội - bộ binh, xe tăng, pháo binh và không quân - để tạo thành đội quân tối thượng có khả năng thống trị chiến trường trong cả chiến dịch PvP và PvE.

Chiến lược Chiến thuật
Một chỉ huy thực thụ giành chiến thắng với tổn thất tối thiểu. Những lựa chọn của bạn - lộ trình tấn công, thứ tự triển khai đơn vị và sử dụng kỹ năng chiến thuật thời gian thực - ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả trận chiến. Làm chủ chiến lược chiến trường, tham gia chiến đấu RTS căng thẳng và giành hết chiến thắng này đến chiến thắng khác trong cuộc chiến hành động nhịp độ nhanh.

Chiến tranh Liên minh
Bạn sẽ chọn chiến tranh hay hòa bình? Thành lập hoặc gia nhập một quân đoàn, mở rộng lãnh thổ và tham gia những trận chiến nhiều người chơi quy mô lớn toàn cầu. Phối hợp với đồng minh, nghiền nát căn cứ kẻ thù và chứng tỏ sự thống trị của bạn trong cuộc chiến chiến lược quân sự toàn cầu. Xây dựng liên minh, Đè bẹp áp bức!

Hình ảnh
Đồ họa tuyệt đẹp, được chăm chút tỉ mỉ, từ anh hùng, vũ khí cho đến phương tiện và trang bị. Mọi chi tiết đều tỏa sáng với màu sắc sống động và hiệu ứng ngoạn mục, khiến đây trở thành một trong những game chiến lược chiến tranh được thiết kế đẹp nhất thế giới.

data.name: Block.io
data.description_full:
Block.io is a fast, competitive block-puzzle battler where you drop blocks, clear lines, and go head-to-head against players around the world in real time.

Drag colorful blocks onto the 10x10 grid, complete rows and columns to clear them, and chain combos to charge powerful special abilities. The longer your combo, the harder you hit. Outsmart your rival, send garbage blocks to their board, and be the last one standing.

■ REAL-TIME ONLINE 1v1
Get matched with a real opponent and battle live. Every move counts — clear fast, build combos, and crush your rival before they crush you.

■ MULTIPLE MODES
- Solo: practice and chase high combos at your own pace
- 1v1 Duel: classic head-to-head online battles
- 1v4 Arena: survive against four opponents at once
- 2v2 Team: team up and take down the enemy duo

■ 10 SPECIAL ABILITIES
Charge your abilities with combos and unleash them at the perfect moment — slice rows, freeze your rival, drop bombs, raise shields, send mega garbage, and more. Pick your loadout before each match and build your own strategy.

■ SATISFYING COMBO SYSTEM
Chain clears for explosive combos with juicy effects, screen shakes, and rewarding sounds. From GOOD to FANTASTIC — how high can you go?

■ CLASSIC MODES TOO
Prefer a relaxed session? Jump into the classic Block Puzzle mode or the Falling Blocks mode anytime.

■ EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER
Simple drag-and-drop controls anyone can pick up in seconds — but mastering combos, abilities, and timing takes real skill.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Block.io delivers quick, addictive, competitive puzzle action. Climb the ranks, sharpen your strategy, and prove you're the best block puzzler out there.

Download Block.io now and start your first battle

data.name: Rumble Fumble

No endless grinding.
No pay-to-win nonsense.

Just the race you choose, your sense of timing, your strategy —

You form alliances.
You break them when it makes sense.

Control the flow of power…
or calmly point at someone else and make them the next target.

The player in the lead? They can fall in seconds.
The underdog? One smart move and suddenly they’re running the show.

Power never stays still.

It’s about sharp decisions.
Cool heads.
And knowing exactly when to smile… and when to strike.

One vote can flip the entire game.
One choice can turn five players against you.
And every single match tells a different story.

Now the real question is—

Are you ready to survive?

Every round, the battlefield can shift. Vote smart — or regret it later.

Pick your favorite — or learn them all and keep everyone guessing.

Let’s be honest. The game’s more fun when you look good.
Equip a slick skin, show it off in the arena,
and make sure they remember exactly who beat them.

data.name: 解憂小食光：萌系店員養成 & 餐廳模擬經營
data.description_full:
想擁有一間專屬的森林小店嗎？從招募獲得第一位獸耳店員開始，你將與他們一起研發菜單、自由裝潢、傾聽每位顧客藏在美食背後的故事。沒有催促與壓力，只有慢慢的忙碌、小小的成就，和那些不經意就被治癒的瞬間。在《解憂小食光》裡，展開一場悠閒自在的療癒經營之旅。

◆ 招募各族店員，養成最佳夥伴
招募不同種族的夥伴，每位店員都有獨特技能加成與能力傾向。招募店員並依據能力管理，把對的人放對位置，經營效率顯著提升。養成系統包含等級、星級、屬性、技能等多條成長線，收集店員圖鑑，解鎖人物小傳，逐步擴大商業版圖，讓小店從一人經營發展到溫暖家園。輕鬆當老闆，享受休閒又療癒的養成樂趣。

◆ 傾聽顧客故事，解鎖暖心劇情
每位上門的客人都有屬於自己的回憶與秘密。透過對話與專屬任務，幫助他們找回「記憶碎片」，解鎖豐富的故事線與人物小傳。隨著好感度逐步提升，特殊顧客會成為常客，帶來更穩定的收入。經營的不只是小店，更是人與人之間的溫暖連結。在休閒之餘，體驗沉浸式的暖心劇情。

◆ 研發多樣菜譜，親手創造美味
從榛果司康、海嶼小麵到奶油杯麵，超多創意料理等你解鎖，涵蓋飲品、烘焙、甜品、輕食等豐富品類。簡單卻有挑戰的反應類小玩法「抓時機點擊」，在指針轉盤上按順序精準投入食材，順序錯誤就失敗，解壓又療癒，讓每一道菜都充滿親手製作的成就感。

◆ 自由裝潢改造，隨心打造家園
桌椅、壁紙、地毯、擺飾…所有家具都透過隨機合成獲得，每次合成都像開盲盒一樣充滿驚喜！你可以自由規劃佈置，搭配古典雅緻、簡約時尚、浪漫童話、田園鄉村等不同主題，打造獨一無二的森系小店。從室內裝潢到花園種植收集鮮花，每個角落都由你決定。

◆ 穿搭百變風格，展現個性魅力
店員不只是幫手，還能換裝搭配當季流行服飾。甜美、幹練、華麗、簡約…各種風格隨心切換。收集限定時裝，提升店鋪魅力值，吸引更多客人上門。解鎖每一位店員的人物小傳，與店員互動培養親密度，讓每一次換裝都充滿樂趣與成就感。

【推薦給這樣的你】
喜歡療癒畫風、溫馨日常、慢節奏放鬆的你
喜歡餐廳／咖啡館／美食題材的模擬經營玩家
喜歡萌系角色、店員收集與養成、換裝搭配的你
喜歡自由裝潢佈置、打造專屬空間風格的裝修控
想在休閒裡體驗爆單忙碌感，或想衝榜找目標的你
喜歡放置掛機、離線收益、享受美食帶來幸福感的人

※遊戲內容與活動規則請以實際版本為準。

data.name: Tiểu Cường 3Q
data.description_full:
Kiếp trước ta chỉ là một con kiến nhỏ bé trong thế giới loài người, vậy mà kiếp này lại chuyển sinh đến thời không Tam Quốc của côn trùng! Tuy đều là sâu bọ, nhưng kiếp này ta nhất định sẽ làm nên chuyện lớn!!!
Ta vẫn còn đang chìm đắm trong giấc mộng đẹp thì ngoài cửa bỗng vang lên tiếng: “Hài nhi Phụng Tiên cầu kiến.” Phụng Tiên? Sao nghe quen vậy… Ta còn có con rồi sao? Khoan đã… sao lại có cảm giác chẳng lành thế này...
Trong thế giới vi mô kỳ diệu này, côn trùng không còn là những sinh vật đơn giản nữa. Chúng xuyên không đến thời Tam Quốc, sở hữu trí tuệ và ngôn ngữ. Châu chấu Lưu Bị thống lĩnh “Thục Hán Châu Chấu”, bọ ngựa Tào Tháo dẫn dắt “Ngụy Bọ Ngựa”, còn bọ cánh cứng Tôn Quyền nắm giữ “Đông Ngô Bọ Cánh Cứng”. Vì hòa bình của Tam Quốc Côn Trùng, các loài sâu bọ tập hợp lại, cùng nhau bước vào hành trình phiêu lưu vừa kỳ thú vừa hài hước!
【Diễn giải vui, cải biên có chọn lọc】
Chúng tôi lấy côn trùng làm chủ thể thể hiện, kết hợp các danh tướng Tam Quốc với nhiều loài côn trùng khác nhau. Trong thiết kế, chúng tôi cố gắng giữ lại đặc trưng nguyên bản của từng loài, đồng thời hòa trộn các yếu tố nổi bật của danh tướng trong các tác phẩm giải trí như: vũ khí, tạo hình, trang phục, chiến tích nổi tiếng hay điển tích để phát triển thành kỹ năng riêng biệt.
【Tạm biệt “cày cuốc - nạp tiền”, nâng cấp nhàn rỗi】
“Chơi nhẹ nhàng” và “giảm áp lực” là mục tiêu thiết kế của trò chơi. Chúng tôi mang đến một hoặc nhiều lối chơi đơn giản nhưng đa dạng trải nghiệm. Người chơi có thể tự do khám phá theo cách mình thích. Game hỗ trợ treo máy, kể cả offline vẫn thu thập tài nguyên liên tục. Từ kỹ năng, tăng sao đến tiến cấp – hệ thống phát triển đa chiều giúp tướng côn trùng của bạn nhanh chóng tăng lực chiến, dễ dàng đánh bại kẻ địch.
【Phó bản đa dạng, vượt ải côn trùng】
Bắt côn trùng, hang động, bờ sông, hốc cây phiêu lưu… đồng thời tái hiện các trận chiến kinh điển thời Tam Quốc, mở ra một thế giới Tam Quốc Côn Trùng hoàn toàn khác biệt.
【Vận may bùng nổ – quay liên tục】
Mỗi lần chiêu mộ, chỉ cần đạt điều kiện là có thể nhận thêm một lượt miễn phí. Tích tiểu thành đại, sở hữu hàng ngàn loài côn trùng – thống nhất thế giới côn trùng không còn là giấc mơ!
【Liên minh hội tụ – tranh tài liên server】
Tạo liên minh, chiêu mộ đồng đội, cùng nhau hợp tác chiến đấu, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm và chiến thuật. So tài với người chơi từ các server khác, tận hưởng trọn vẹn niềm vui giao lưu và sự kịch tính của chiến đấu!

data.name: ArcPulse
data.description_full:
Feel the rhythm. Hit the pulse.

ArcPulse is a fast-paced rhythm reaction game that challenges your timing, focus, and reflexes. Each round generates a unique sequence of glowing pulse points across the screen. Your goal is simple: tap each pulse in sync with its corresponding tone as it lights up. One mistimed tap and your rhythm is broken.

Key Features

- Dynamic pulse sequences: Every round is different. The game randomly generates 3 to 7 pulse points with varying positions, intervals, and tones, ensuring no two rounds play the same.

- Progressive difficulty: The first few rounds ease you in with fixed intervals and simple patterns. As you advance, the game introduces dual-tone cross patterns, variable timing between 400ms and 900ms, and echo delay effects that test your muscle memory and prediction.

- Audio-visual feedback: Each correct tap produces a satisfying tone and a visual burst of light. Hit with perfect timing and you will hear an ascending tone while the pulse radiates with an intensified glow. Miss a beat and the screen signals your mistake with a clear visual and audio cue.

- Dark neon aesthetic: The interface features a dark background with cyan, pink, and purple neon accents. Glowing pulse points and subtle animated backgrounds create an immersive environment that keeps your focus on the rhythm.

- Personal records: Your longest streak and best flow rating are saved locally on your device. Compete against your own performance and push for higher scores with each session.

- Zero permissions required: ArcPulse does not require internet access, location, camera, microphone, or any sensitive permissions. All game data stays on your device.

How to Play

1. A sequence of pulse points appears on screen.
2. Each pulse lights up one by one with a corresponding tone.
3. Tap each pulse at the right moment to score.
4. Complete the full sequence to pass the round.
5. Two missed taps end the round. Retry and improve your streak.

ArcPulse is designed for quick 15-to-30-second sessions, making it perfect for commutes, breaks, or any moment you want to test your rhythm.
data.description_short: Tap glowing pulses in sync with dynamic tones. A rhythm reaction game.

Features:
- 15 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty, from simple straight paths to complex multi-entry puzzles with obstacles
- Intuitive tap-to-place controls: tap any empty cell and choose a direction for the marker
- Clear visual feedback with color-coded entry, exit, and obstacle cells

- Best turn records saved locally, encouraging replay to optimize your strategy

- Calm and focused visual style with a light gray board and subtle blue-green accents
- No timers, no pressure - think through each move at your own pace

As you progress through the levels, new challenges are introduced: multiple wind entries requiring coordinated paths, fixed obstacle cells that force detours, and larger 7x7 boards for more complex puzzles. Each level can be replayed to achieve a better turn count, and the game tracks your best performance for every stage.

FlexVane offers a satisfying blend of spatial reasoning and forward planning in a relaxing board game format. Perfect for short play sessions during a commute or a coffee break.

data.name: Weddings Match3
data.description_full:
Weddings Match3 – A Romantic Stacking Puzzle Game

Welcome to Weddings Match3, a charming and addictive tile‑matching game inspired by the popular stacking puzzle style. Your mission is simple: tap three identical wedding‑themed tiles to make them disappear. But be careful – tiles are stacked in layers, and you can only select tiles that are fully uncovered!

How to Play

The game is easy to learn but offers deep strategic fun:

Wedding tiles are piled on top of each other in various rows and columns.

You can only tap a tile that is not covered by any other tile.

Each time you select three matching wedding icons, they are removed from the board.

You have a limited number of slots at the bottom of the screen. When you tap a tile, it moves into one of these slots.

If the slots become full without matching three, the game ends.

Clear all tiles from the board to complete the level and advance to the next romantic challenge.

The more levels you complete, the harder they become – with more tiles, tighter layouts, and increasing strategic demands.

Game Features

Challenging Stacking System
Wedding items hide behind others. Plan your clicking order carefully to uncover the tiles you need. One wrong move could block your progress!

Dozens of Romantic Items
Celebrate love with a wide variety of beautifully designed wedding‑themed icons – each with bright, elegant visuals that capture the magic of a perfect wedding day.

Special Power‑ups & Boosters

Shuffle – Rearranges all remaining tiles on the board.

Undo – Reverts your last move.

Extra Slot – Temporarily increases the bottom storage space.

Relaxing Sound & Visuals
Soft, romantic background music and satisfying pop effects make every match enjoyable. The elegant colour palette – whites, golds, pinks, and soft pastels – creates a stress‑free, dreamy atmosphere.

Hundreds of Levels
With hundreds of uniquely designed levels, the challenge never ends. New levels are added regularly to keep you engaged.

Offline Play
No internet connection needed. Play anytime, anywhere – whether you're planning your own wedding or simply relaxing at home.

Why You'll Love It

Simple to learn, but requires strategic thinking – perfect for casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

No time pressure – play at your own pace and enjoy the romantic theme.

Hundreds of levels with increasing difficulty keep the game fresh and exciting.

Free to play – optional hints and power‑ups available when you need extra help.

Beautiful wedding theme – every tile and animation is designed to make you feel the joy and elegance of a wedding celebration.

Ready for a romantic challenge?

Download Weddings Match3 today and match your way through a world of love and celebration. Can you clear every board and become the ultimate wedding‑matching champion? Whether you're a bride‑to‑be, a wedding planner, or just someone who loves a good puzzle, this game is the perfect way to celebrate love – one match at a time!

data.name: Arototo
data.description_full:
Every arrow is boxed in, pointing straight into another one. Tap one and it only moves if its path to the edge is clear. So this isn't about speed. It's about the order. Find the one sequence that frees every arrow, and the whole jammed grid empties out.

There's always a way out. Your job is to find it.

HOW IT WORKS
• A grid packed with arrows, all blocking each other
• Tap an arrow to send it off the board, if its path is clear
• Blocked? Work out which arrow to move first. Then the next.
• Keep going until every last arrow is gone

No luck. No random boards. Every level has a clean solution, and it's on you to see it. One wrong order and you're stuck, so back up, look again, and find the way through.

WHY IT STICKS
• The quiet click of a jam coming undone
• A few minutes that turn the noise in your head down
• Pure logic, not another mindless tapper
• Easy to pick up, genuinely hard to put down

Made for people who like to think a few moves ahead. The arrows are stuck. You're the one who gets them out.

Find the order. Free every arrow.

data.name: Bus Crowd - Traffic Jam

Welcome to Bus Crowd, a colorful bus puzzle game built around traffic jam strategy, passenger matching, and smart parking choices. 🚌🚦

A crowded station is full of waiting passengers, and buses with different colors and seat capacities are ready to roll. - Fill Buses to Open Slots: A full vehicle departs and opens its parking space for another move. Avoid leaving buses that are not fully filled in the slots for too long.
- Solve the Jam with Strategy: Use color sort logic, bus sort thinking, and car parking style planning to handle every traffic puzzle. 🧩
- Use Boosters When Stuck: Helpful boosters can adjust buses, guide passengers, or open paths when a tricky jam blocks your progress. 🚀

- Bus Jam Puzzle Fun: Mix color matching, passenger boarding, parking slots, and traffic jam choices in a challenge that feels easy to start and satisfying to solve.
- Bus Out Challenge: Study the arrows, send the right vehicles out of crowded layouts, and enjoy the moment when a blocked station finally starts moving.
- Bus Escape Moments: Fill buses, open lanes, and create clever escape style solutions as each full vehicle leaves the station. 🚍
- Traffic Escape Challenge: Handle car jam inspired layouts, parking jam pressure, and bus rush moments with careful observation instead of random moves.
- Brain Teaser Levels: Count seats, compare passengers, and use smart strategy to solve each puzzle with a real sense of progress. 🧠
- Passenger Matching Flow: Watch large crowds stream into colorful buses, see vehicles depart one by one, and turn chaos into a smooth boarding flow.
- Diverse Boosters: Use different tools for buses and passengers, then decide which option gives the best value when the station gets tricky. ✨
- Bright 3D Station Scenes: Enjoy vivid buses, lively passengers, smooth boarding animations, and relaxing traffic flow.

Bus Crowd is made for players who enjoy bus games, parking games, bus mania, color sort puzzles, traffic jam puzzles, and clever car jam challenges. Match passengers, fill buses, open parking slots, and solve each bus game with satisfying flow. Download Bus Crowd today and master the jam! 🚦

data.name: Genshin Impact - Funtap
data.description_full:
Step into Teyvat, a vast world teeming with life and flowing with elemental energy.

You and your sibling arrived here from another world. Separated by an unknown god, stripped of your powers, and cast into a deep slumber, you now awake to a world very different from when you first arrived.

Thus begins your journey across Teyvat to seek answers from The Seven — the gods of each element. Along the way, prepare to explore every inch of this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

MASSIVE OPEN WORLD

Climb any mountain, swim across any river, and glide over the world below, taking in the jaw-dropping scenery each step of the way. And if you stop to investigate a wandering Seelie or strange mechanism, who knows what you might discover?

ELEMENTAL COMBAT SYSTEM

Harness the seven elements to unleash elemental reactions. Anemo, Electro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, and Geo interact in all sorts of ways, and Vision wielders have the power to turn this to their advantage.

Will you vaporize Hydro with Pyro, electro-charge it with Electro, or freeze it with Cryo? Your mastery of the elements will give you the upper hand in battle and exploration.

BEAUTIFUL VISUALS

Feast your eyes on the world around you, with a stunning art style, real-time rendering, and finely tuned character animations delivering you a truly immersive visual experience. Lighting and weather all change naturally over time, bringing every detail of this world to life.

SOOTHING SOUNDTRACK

Let the beautiful sounds of Teyvat draw you in as you explore the expansive world around you. Performed by the world's top orchestras such as London Philharmonic Orchestra and Shanghai Symphony Orchestra, the soundtrack changes seamlessly with the time and gameplay to match the mood.

BUILD YOUR DREAM TEAM

Team up with a diverse cast of characters in Teyvat, each with their own unique personalities, stories, and abilities. Discover your favorite party combinations and level up your characters to help you conquer even the most daunting of enemies and domains.

JOURNEY WITH FRIENDS

Team up with friends across various platforms to trigger more elemental action, tackle tricky boss fights, and conquer challenging domains together to reap rich rewards.

As you stand atop the peaks of Jueyun Karst and take in the rolling clouds and vast terrain stretching out before you, you may wish to stay in Teyvat a little longer... But until you are reunited with your lost sibling, how can you rest? Go forth, Traveler, and begin your adventure!

WANDER THE THOUSAND STARS, SHAPE MYRIADS OF WONDERLANDS

Enter Miliastra Wonderland — a dreamlike realm of adventure, creation, and socializing. Customize your Manekins, meet friends in the Lobby, tackle challenges in various stages, or craft your own unique worlds in the Miliastra Sandbox!

data.name: ReTown
data.description_full:
In ReTown, every sunrise marks not just another day of survival, but a shift in the very foundation of the world around you. As the sun rises, the once-familiar terrain mutates—land masses tilt, new pathways emerge, and towering ridges rise from the ground, altering the battlefield and forcing you to rethink your every move. This isn’t just a fight against the undead—it’s a fight against the land itself.

At the heart of this chaos stands your Sacred Tree, a glowing monument of life in a rotting world. Its roots run deep, binding together the last fragments of nature’s magic. If it falls, so does all hope. Each night, waves of zombies swarm from every direction—shambling corpses, feral sprinters, armored abominations—each deadlier and more cunning than the last.

Survival isn’t just about swinging a weapon; it’s about adapting. Craft fortifications from scarce resources, place traps in shifting chokepoints, and upgrade your defenses to withstand the coming night. Your enemies will learn—they will climb, break, and swarm in new ways, testing every weak point in your strategy.

But danger also brings opportunity. As you explore the unstable terrain, you’ll uncover hidden resource caches, rare weapons, and ancient relics to empower your defenses. Every decision matters—do you risk venturing further for a powerful upgrade, or stay close to protect the tree?

The undead are relentless. The world is unpredictable. The only constant… is the fight.

data.name: Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle
data.description_full:
You stare at the odd-shaped block on the screen. You narrow your eyes, draw a line right down the middle, and swipe. Bam. A perfect 50/50 split.

That satisfying feeling is exactly what Perfect Half - Slice Puzzle is all about. It is a casual game designed to test your eye for symmetry and see how well you can judge exact sizes.

The goal is straightforward: you need to cut in half whatever appears on your screen. You do not need complicated controls or quick reflexes. Just use your finger to divide shapes and try to get as close to a flawless 50/50 ratio as possible. Sometimes the objects are simple. Other times, they are tricky asymmetrical polygons that will turn this into a real brain teaser.

How to play:
• Look closely at the shape in front of you.
• Swipe across the screen to draw a line and slice shapes.
• Aim to create two perfectly equal parts.
• Hit the target accuracy score to move forward. If it is not quite an even cut, you simply retry the level until you get it right.

What to expect:
• Pure focus: This relaxing game has no timers, allowing you to take your time and plan your move.
• Mind training: Sharpen your spatial awareness in a logic puzzle that gently pushes your brain to think differently.
• Play anywhere: Dive into this casual puzzle during your daily commute or while winding down for the night.

Grab your device, trust your instincts, and see if you have what it takes to make the perfect split.
data.description_short: Swipe to cut in half! Divide shapes into equal parts in this slice puzzle.

data.name: GlideShard
data.description_full:
GlideShard is a quick memory training game designed for short sessions during commutes, breaks, or whenever you want to challenge your brain.

GAMEPLAY:
Watch colorful shards appear on a 5x5 grid. When each shard appears, swipe to mark an entire row or column as a memory path. After all shards have appeared, you have 10 seconds to recall and tap the marked paths in the correct sequence. Match the sequence correctly to advance.

FEATURES:
- 50 progressive levels teaching the swipe-and-recall mechanic
- Early levels use 3 shards with unique colors to help you learn
- Later levels introduce color repetition and similar gradients for increased challenge
- 10-second memory countdown adds pressure and excitement
- Best time tracking for each level so you can beat your personal records
- Infinite Mode unlocked after completing all 50 levels for endless practice
- Clean, minimalist visual design with soft colors and smooth animations

DIFFICULTY progression:
- Levels 1-10: 3 shards, unique colors, gentle introduction
- Levels 11-30: 4-5 shards, colors may repeat, medium challenge
- Levels 31-50: Color gradients added, highest difficulty
- Infinite Mode: Random 8-10 shards, unlimited practice

Each session takes 20-40 seconds, making it perfect for quick mental exercise throughout your day.

data.name: Sort the Cargo
data.description_full:
Game Description
Welcome to Cargo Sort — the ultimate container-sorting puzzle! Every level drops a jumbled mess of goods into a cargo container. Your mission? Tap to move items, match three or more of the same kind, and clear the container before it overflows. With stunning, smooth sliding animations, and satisfying pop effects, every tap feels like organizing a real warehouse. Train your brain, kill boredom, and become the master sorter!
Features
Endless Levels — Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles, from easy to brain-melting hard.
Simple & Addictive — Just tap to move items. One finger, infinite fun.
Visual Satisfaction — Bright graphics, juicy pop animations, and ASMR-level sound effects.
Brain Training — Each level tests your sorting logic, spatial planning, and quick thinking.
Quick Rounds — Perfect for bus rides, coffee breaks, or late-night couch sessions.
For Everyone — Kids love the colors, adults love the strategy. All ages welcome.
How to Play
Items arrive randomly inside the cargo container. Tap an item to pick it up, then tap an empty slot to drop it. When three or more identical items line up, they pop and disappear! Your goal: clear all items from the container. But be careful — the container has limited space. If it fills up before you clear everything, it's game over. Plan ahead, group wisely, and use the temporary storage slots strategically.

Why You’ll Love It
A level can be completed in just a few minutes, perfect for a quick game during your commute, while waiting in line, or before bed. Watching the shelves go from a chaotic mess to empty is incredibly satisfying and addictive. You'll never get tired of it. Combined with crisp sound effects and smooth animations, it offers maximum stress relief. Whether you're a seasoned match-3 player or a casual gamer, you'll find your rhythm here.
Ready to Sort?
A variety of levels, each more challenging than the last. From beginner containers to the full-load puzzles, every level tests both your logic and reflexes. Don't let your goods pile up—download Cargo Sort now and start your warehouse organization journey!
data.description_short: Sort, match & clear the cargo! Tap to organize the container!

The secret base never sleeps, and the fighter jets and armored convoys show no mercy. STRATEGY & RISK
Everything depends on your touch and sense of the moment:
Split-Second Timing: Wait for the perfect gap between roaring jets and moving convoys. A second of hesitation is all it takes for the tarmac to claim its prize.
Adrenaline Multiplier: The stakes rise with every single meter you cross. The deeper you go down the airstrip, the higher your score climbs.
Push Your Luck: Bank your progress or risk it all for a new record. One mistake, and your winged pilot is sent right back to square one.
SECRET BASE REALISM
No compromises, just the raw, heavy rhythm of a military airfield:
Badass Gear: Your hero is fully equipped for action—aviator goggles, tactical belt, combat boots, and a buzzing propeller on his back!
Military Landscape: Heavy traffic unfolds against a backdrop of grey hangars, green hatches, and vehicles sporting light military camo.
Dangerous Sky & Land: Half of the ground traffic has been replaced by aircraft taking off right in front of you. Learn to "read" the runway in real-time.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
One-Handed Control: Super simple mechanics—guide your pilot to take-off completely on the go.
High-Speed Afterburner: Short, intense sessions that keep you on the edge of your seat.
Immersive Military Audio: Powerful engine roars and sirens capture the high tension of every single step.
The runway is clear. Are you ready to prove your feathered ace can outsmart all the high-tech machinery of Area 51 in ChickenFly Road Up?

data.name: 幻櫻物語:心動少女 日系少女放置戀愛手遊
data.description_full:
連接異世界的時空裂隙悄然出現，來自彼端的旅人穿過光門，踏入這片陌生的土地，與你締結契約。她們擁有古老傳承的力量，卻對眼前的異世界充滿好奇。
而你，成為了她們在此地的第一位指引者。

【· 異界來客 · 與你締結契約 ·】
遊戲中有超過百位來自異世界的角色等待與你相遇。
她們的身分各異：有出身名門的劍士、鑽研元素奧秘的學者、背負使命的神官，也有隱匿於暗影中的刺客。每一位都擁有專屬的立繪設計與技能體系。
透過關卡、活動與招募，你可以邀請她們加入隊伍，成為並肩作戰的夥伴。

【· 回合對戰 · 陣容搭配定勝負 ·】
你需要根據敵人特性，合理安排角色的站位與出手順序。前排承傷、後排輸出、治療續航、控場干擾——不同職能各司其職，方能克敵制勝。
技能之間存在連攜可能，部分角色的組合可觸發額外效果。如何搭配陣容，是你需要持續鑽研的課題。

【· 角色養成 · 穩步提升戰力 ·】
每位夥伴都可以透過戰鬥與資源投入逐步成長。
升級提升基礎屬性，突破解鎖更高等級上限，技能強化增強招式威力，裝備更換帶來直觀的戰力加成。
養成路徑清晰，資源投放節奏平穩。無需盲目追趕，每天推進一點，隊伍自會日漸強大。

【· 競技切磋 · 與其他召喚師一較高下 ·】
競技場是檢驗陣容強度的最佳場所。
匹配實力相近的對手，自動戰鬥決出勝負。你的角色練度、陣容搭配、戰術布局，將在對局中接受客觀檢驗。
勝場累積提升段位，賽季結算發放獎勵。排名前列可獲得專屬榮譽標識，普通玩家亦有穩定資源入帳。

【· 主線冒險 · 一步步揭開世界真相 ·】
遊戲主線以章節形式推進，每一章包含若干戰鬥關卡。
從最初的裂隙周邊區域，到深入異世界腹地，沿途遭遇形形色色的敵人與盟友。關卡難度循序漸進，快來開啟你的頭腦風暴！

【· 日常福利 · 細水長流的陪伴感 ·】
每日登入領取豪禮，累計簽到獲得額外饋贈。
完成日常任務累積活躍度，豐富活動產出稀有道具。
這是一款尊重你時間的遊戲。想認真鑽研可以盡興，想輕鬆收集也能自得其樂。

裂隙已開，異界的風正吹向這片大陸。
你的契約，從這一刻開始。

The sun is blazing, the music is pumping, and the cars on the beach highway aren't slowing down for anyone! Tropical Multiplier: The stakes rise with every single step across the hot sand. The further you push forward, the higher your vacation score climbs.
Push Your Luck: Bank your progress or risk it all for a new high score. One mistake, and you are sent right back to the starting line.

Tropical Landscape: Forget grey asphalt. Dash through golden sand, circular sand pits instead of boring manholes, and light green bushes lining the road.
Summer Traffic: The cars perfectly match the sunny resort atmosphere but move just as fast. Learn to "read" this sandy-green highway in real-time.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT:
One-Handed Control: Super simple mechanics—guide your chilled-out chicken to the beach completely on the go.
High-Speed Relaxation: Short, intense, and incredibly vibrant gameplay sessions that keep you hooked.

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

Ever wanted to run your own bakery from scratch? Each item has its own prep steps, so the kitchen always feels alive and varied rather than repetitive. As your bakery reputation grows, you unlock new recipes, better equipment, and shop upgrades that let you serve more customers faster.

The supermarket side of the game adds a layer most baking games skip. You are not just cooking, you are managing stock levels, rotating products, and making sure nothing goes stale before it sells. Watch your shelves, restock at the right moment, and keep the sales floor looking full and fresh. It is that satisfying store manager loop on top of the kitchen gameplay.

Serving customers is quick and readable. A customer walks in, you see what they want, you grab or prepare the item, and you hand it over. Get it right and fast and your tips grow. Let the queue pile up and satisfaction drops. The time management side scales gently as you progress, so it never tips into frustration.

Why players keep coming back:

Bakery cooking game with a real management layer, not just tapping a single button on repeat.

Dozen of food items to bake and sell, from classic bread loaves to layered cakes and glazed pastries.

Shop upgrades that visibly change your store, bigger display cases, faster ovens, and a wider product range.

Customer service gameplay that rewards speed and accuracy without punishing early mistakes too hard.

Relaxing game pacing that fits a ten-minute session or a longer play through equally well.

Colorful, detailed food visuals that make every freshly baked item look genuinely appetizing.

Simple controls that feel smooth whether you are new to simulator games or have played dozens of them.

Progress that carries meaning, each upgrade you buy and each recipe you unlock changes how your shift actually plays.

If you enjoy cooking games, time management games, bakery games, food serving games, or any kind of shop simulator, this is built for you. The mix of baking, stocking, and serving customers gives it more variety than a single-mechanic game, and the upgrade path keeps sessions feeling purposeful.

Peel, Match, and Reveal!

Welcome to Bead Peel, the ultimate satisfying puzzle game where every tap removes colorful beads and reveals beautiful 3D creations hidden underneath.

Enjoy a relaxing yet challenging experience as you match colors, clear layers of beads, and gradually uncover adorable models, funny characters, and surprising objects.

Whether you want to relax after a busy day or challenge your puzzle-solving skills, Bead Peel offers endless satisfying moments.

How to Play

• Match and remove beads of the same color
• Clear layers strategically to reveal hidden models
• Complete objectives and unlock new creations
• Discover unique shapes, characters, and collectibles
• Enjoy smooth animations and satisfying visual effects

Features

🎨 Colorful and relaxing gameplay

🧩 Easy to learn, challenging to master

✨ Satisfying bead peeling mechanics

🏆 Hundreds of handcrafted levels

🎁 Unlock unique 3D models and surprises

🌟 Smooth visual effects and relaxing experience

📱 Play anytime, anywhere

Why You'll Love Bead Peel

Every level presents a new object waiting to be revealed. Watch colorful beads disappear layer by layer as hidden creations come to life before your eyes.

From cute animals and funny faces to unique collectibles, each completed model delivers a rewarding sense of accomplishment.

If you enjoy relaxing puzzle games, satisfying ASMR-style gameplay, color matching challenges, and collection mechanics, you'll love Bead Peel.

Start peeling, matching, and revealing today!
data.description_short: Peel colorful beads, reveal amazing models, and relax your mind!

data.name: Slingshot Sniper Strike
data.description_full:
This accessible physics-based casual slingshot game is designed for players of all ages. You can relax yourself in spare time, and keep challenging to beat your own high scores.
How to Play
Pull back the slingshot on screen to charge power and adjust the shooting angle, release your finger to launch the projectile.
Follow realistic parabolic physics trajectories to aim at hanging balloon targets. Smash them to earn in-game scores.
The game records your real-time score and permanent high score for every round. You can optimize your aiming strategy repeatedly to break your personal record.
Balloons will be placed at different distances and positions as you play. You need to tweak your pull force and launch angle to clear all targets successfully.
data.description_short: Pull back your slingshot to fire projectiles and smash targets.

data.name: Sheep Escape: Easy Rewards!
data.description_full:
Embark on a fun, mentally stimulating puzzle adventure! A once quiet farm has been thrown into chaos, leaving dozens of fluffy sheep trapped with no escape. Put your strategic skills to the test: plan smart moves to rescue every stranded sheep and prevent them from colliding with one another. Are you ready to take on this creative, highly addictive puzzle game?
Gameplay: Begin Your Sheep Rescue
The lively farm is filled with trapped sheep, each limited to one of four fixed diagonal paths. These lovely animals can only move straight along their designated routes. Tap a sheep to set it on its way to freedom, but stay alert! If another sheep blocks the path, a collision will happen and derail your plan. Figure out the optimal order of movement to rescue all sheep safely and ace every level.
Game Features
Original Diagonal Puzzle Mechanics
Thanks to its distinctive diagonal movement system, the game offers a totally unique puzzle experience. You’ll need to think ahead with every action to avoid collisions and pull off seamless rescues.
Diverse Levels with Gradual Difficulty
The game features a gentle learning curve, starting off easy and growing more challenging step by step. A huge selection of thoughtfully designed levels guarantees hours of entertainment and nonstop challenges for puzzle lovers.
Enjoyable Brain Boost
Each level serves as a fun logic workout. As you dive into the gameplay, you’ll naturally sharpen your logical thinking, heighten your observation and improve your ability to solve problems.
Join puzzle enthusiasts across the globe to rescue these cute sheep! This free-to-play mind game is perfect for players of every age. See how many tough levels you can beat, and put your strategic thinking to the test today!
data.description_short: Strategize diagonal moves and save lovely farm sheep!

data.name: Bubble Popper
data.description_full:
Welcome to Bubble Popper, the ultimate high-speed bubble popping speedrun game!

Test your reflexes, strategy, and speed as you pop, blast, and chain your way through 150 challenging levels across 15 vibrant stages. With strict time limits, increasing speeds, and unique bubble physics, every split second counts!

Can you beat the clock and set the ultimate high score?

🎮 EXCITING GAMEPLAY CLASS
Tap to pop bubbles as they float, drift, and bounce across the screen. Speed is key, but strategy is your secret weapon. Plan your pops, manage the timer, and unlock your true speedrunning potential!

🫧 UNIQUE SPECIAL BUBBLES
Encounter four distinct classes of bubbles, each bringing its own twist to the field:
• Normal Bubbles: The classic, glossy bubbles. Popping them creates satisfying pitch-modulated sound effects.
• Multiplying Bubbles: Pop them and watch them split into 8 to 16 smaller bubbles bursting outward at high speed. Clear them last for a spectacular particle fountain!
• Dynamite Bubbles: Touch them to trigger a massive explosion, clearing all neighboring bubbles in a wide radius. (Maximum 3 appearances per level, never spawns at the very beginning).
• Swirl Bubbles: Unstable portal bubbles that last for only 8 seconds. Pop them quickly to convert all nearby bubbles into multiplying bubbles for epic chain reactions!

⚡ POWERFUL PERKS & UPGRADES
Stuck on a tough level? Equip and activate powerful perks to turn the tide:
• Time-Dilation Hourglass: Slow down time by 50% for 5 seconds to plan your precision pops.
• Bubble Shield (Second Chance): Grants an automatic 5-second grace period extension when your timer hits zero.
• Dynamite Overcharge: A permanent slot upgrade that increases the detonation radius of all Dynamite bubbles by 25%.
• Dynamite Spawn 20%: Boosts the random spawn probability of Dynamite slots in a level to 20%.
• Enable All Perks: A crown jewel upgrade that allows you to equip and activate all owned perks simultaneously for maximum power!

🎨 PREMIUM COSMETIC SKINS
Style your board with beautiful, high-quality visual skins! Purchase them using in-game Coins or Diamonds:
• Neon Cyber (Vibrant magenta glow)
• Retro Arcade (Pixelized golden-yellow border)
• Liquid Metallic (Reflective chrome droplets)
• Ocean Pearl (Iridescent pinkish-white glow)
• Forest Jade (Translucent marbled green)
• Frozen Glace (Ice-blue crystal shapes)
• Cosmic Nebula (Deep space silver stars)
• Gold Leaf (Polished gold finish)
• Ember Fire (Obsidian red with rising fire particles)

🏆 REWARDS & PROGRESSION
• Level Completion: Rewards you with 5 Diamonds.
• Stage Completion: Rewards you with a massive one-time completion bonus of 50 Diamonds (replays reward 5 Diamonds).
• Corner Fireworks: Completing a stage triggers a spectacular, rich firework display shooting from all 4 corners of the screen that continues until you tap the screen!

Download Bubble Popper today and see how fast you can pop!
data.description_short: Pop bubbles, use powerful perks, unlock custom skins & speedrun 150 stages!

data.name: Logic Trail: Brain Puzzle
data.description_full:
🧩 Clue by Clue — One Step at a Time 🧩

Love logic puzzles? This one unfolds differently. Instead of seeing all the clues at once, you get them one by one. Each new clue depends on the answer you just figured out. Piece by piece, the full picture reveals itself.

🎯 How It Works
Follow the clues provided step by step to find the correct option.

🧠 Think Step by Step
No guessing allowed. Every answer must follow perfectly from the given clues. One wrong move, and you might block yourself from solving the rest. But don’t worry — you can always backtrack and try a different path.

🔍 Clues Build on Clues
Later clues might refer back to earlier answers. It’s like solving a mystery where each new hint makes the previous ones even clearer.

📈 More Cells, Deeper Logic
As you level up, the clues get trickier. But the rule stays the same: finish one clue, get the next. There’s no time limit — just pure, satisfying deduction.

🏆 The Thrill of Unfolding
There’s a special feeling when the final clue appears and you place that last answer. All the pieces click together. You didn’t have the full picture at the start — you built it, clue by clue.

Ready to test your logical mind? Start with the first clue and see where the trail leads… 🕵️‍♂️🔢✅

data.name: Arrow quest:Lucky Reward
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward — a gentle puzzle journey where every arrow has somewhere to go.

On each board, arrows point in different directions. Some look left, some look right, others up or down. Your task is simple but thoughtful: release each arrow the way it faces, and watch it slide off the board. No dragging. No rotating. Just pure, careful decision-making.

But there's a quiet challenge beneath the calm surface. If two arrows cross paths and touch, your run loses one chance. You begin every level with three tries. Let them collide too many times, and you'll need to start over.

This is not a game about speed. It's about seeing the board clearly before making a move. Which arrow should go first? Which one is trapped until another leaves? Step by step, the puzzle unfolds like a gentle riddle.

The visuals are soft and clean. The sounds are light and rewarding. Each solved level brings a small sense of progress — like finishing a page in a favorite book.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Arrow Quest fits quietly into your day. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a little bit of luck.

Can you guide every arrow home without a single mistake? Download Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward and begin your journey today.

data.name: Cluster Clear
data.description_full:
This game focuses on long-term layout planning and precise movement judgment, providing endless strategic depth for puzzle enthusiasts at all levels. There is no restrictive countdown, and each position is a carefully considered decision that shapes your entire gaming journey.
Easily master core strategic games. You can choose three different hexagonal square shapes for each turn. Drag and drop the selected blocks onto the hexagonal chessboard, strategically filling the blank grid. Each position will change the filling state of the chessboard and reshape potential elimination routes in three unique directions, which requires you to consider several steps in advance.
Once any directional line is completely filled, satisfactory grid elimination is triggered and scores are added. Although the game does not have time pressure, it brings ongoing strategic tension - a careless misplaced block may block critical spaces, disrupt layout rhythms, and end the game prematurely. This eternal puzzle has simple mechanisms and infinite possibilities for combinations, allowing you to challenge your strategic limits time and time again!

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

data.name: Soccer Ludo
data.description_full:
Welcome to Soccer Ludo, the board game collection that brings together your absolute favorite childhood board games with the thrilling world of soccer! Soccer Ludo offers three incredibly robust, feature-packed main gameplay pillars:
⚽ 1. Soccer (Tactical Finger Football Action!)
Based on the physics-controlled, tactical gameplay of soccer game, this mode turns the pitch into a sub-billiard style tabletop battlefield. Take turns flicking, aiming, and bouncing your team's bottlecap-style player discs into the football. Use strategy to position your defenders, block your goals, and unleash powerful trick shots to blast the ball into the back of your opponent's net!

Online Mode: Enter the global league! Face off against international players in intense, turn-based soccer PvP match.

Computer Mode: play with your formations, angles, and shooting power against a challenging computer opponent.

Local Mode: Experience immediate, action-packed fun against a friend on the same screen— designed for settling friendly rivalries.

2. 🎲 Ludo (Classic Fun, Reimagined!)
Roll the dice and race your tokens to the center of the board. True to the timeless rules you know and love, our Ludo mode is incredibly versatile, offering an array of sub-modes to fit your schedule:

1v1: Go head-to-head PvP match against a single opponent in a high-stakes tactical showdown. Choose between Quick mode for fast bursts of fun or Classic mode for the authentic experience.

4-Player Mode: Gather a full stadium! Compete against three other players in thrilling Quick or Classic matches.

Vs Computer: No internet? No problem. Test your luck and strategy against our computer mode in both Quick and Classic settings.

Local Play Mode: The ultimate couch multiplayer experience. Pass your phone or tablet around with friends and family locally in Quick or Classic variants.

Live Room: Create or join public Classic live rooms to chat with and play with board game enthusiasts worldwide in real-time. Do not forget to send gifts to your favorite players to show your support and love.

🔴 3. Carrom (The Classic Strike and Pocket Game)
Step up to the square board and experience realistic board physics. Aim your striker, slice your shots, and pocket your carrom men before your opponent does. Soccer Ludo offers multiple ways to play Carrom:

Online Mode: Match up against real players from around the globe in real-time, competitive play.

Intuitive & Smooth Controls: Simple click-and-drag mechanics for Soccer and Carrom, and effortless taps for rolling dice and moving tokens in Ludo.

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?

Every finished run is etched onto the Survivors board under your chosen callsign, ranked by how many steps you outlasted and how many fish you carried out of the storm ice fishing games. data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.

data.name: Ladies Don’t Tempt Immortality
data.description_full:
Survive the Ultimate Temptation on Your Path to Immortality! 🌸⚔️

You are Lin Fan, the chosen one of the Crane Illusion Sect. Born with a Pure Yang Lineage, you are destined to ascend to the heavens.

However, no matter how hard you train, fate sends yet another challenge in your way. Challenges in the shape of seven dangerously beautiful women. Your master is chaotic and unreliable. - Jing Wuyu (The Mischievous Immortal): Chaotic yet caring, her unorthodox lessons often come with a steep price.
- Lan Yunrou (The Martial Mistress): Elegant, severe, and secretly protective... but mercy isn't part of her training plan.
- Bai Wanwan (The Foxy Seductress): Every smile is temptation, every look a tribulation. Determined to tempt you from your destiny, her past unknown...
- Lei Xiao (The Lightning Immortal): Unpredictable, dangerous, and literally shocking.
- Wenren Lanke (The Innocent Troublemaker): A sweet appearance hides the undisputed problem-child of the Sect.
- Yin Ping'er (The Poisoned Tea Saintess): Soft voice, poisonous charm... a beauty you'll never see coming.
- Pan Suqin (The Gentle Soul): The warmest embrace hides the sharpest knife.

Game Features 📖

- A Cinematic Live-Action FMV Experience: Stunning xianxia-inspired effects bring a mythic Chinese fantasy world to life. Feel the spark of every lightning strike!
- A First-Person Immortal Ascension Adventure: Step into the robes of Lin Fan and experience the world through his eyes. Every glance, every touch, and every whispered word can shake your Dao heart.
- Multiple Paths, Infinite Outcomes: Will you walk the merciless path of the true immortal, or lose yourself in mortal passion? Every choice leads to a different fate: enlightenment, downfall, or something in between.
- Train, Duel, and Survive Heavenly Tribulation: Quick-time trials, emotional duels, and comedic chaos await. Survive your master's "training," dodge objects thrown at you, and protect your Divine Essence… at all costs.

Key Highlights 🔑
- Immersive live-action FMV experience
- Chinese myth-inspired fantasy setting
- Multiple endings and branching choices
- Humor, romance, and supernatural chaos

data.name: Europe at War: WW2 Strategy
data.description_full:
The year is 1936. Europe stands on the brink of the most devastating conflict in human history. Take control of one of the 35 available nations and rewrite the course of history in a new grand strategy game where your intellect dictates the outcome!

"Europe at War: WW2 Strategy" is a deep economic and tactical simulator designed for true hardcore strategy fans. Carefully plan your moves, manage resources, and outsmart your enemies in a massive, living world.

🔥 GAME FEATURES:

🌍 Massive Scale & 369+ Regions
Command any of the 35 playable nations on a giant map with over 369 land and sea regions. Fight through the fog of war, control strategic straits, and expand your borders.

🧠 Autonomous AI & Spectator Mode
Every AI-controlled nation acts completely independently: forming alliances, declaring wars, and pursuing its own geopolitical interests. Play to win, or use Spectator Mode to just watch Europe tear itself apart!

⚔️ Deep Tactics & Supply Lines
Wars are won with strategy. Deploy infantry, secure air superiority, and command your naval fleet. Cut off enemy supply lines, encircle their troops, and leave them stranded without access to ports or capitals!

🏭 Economy, Resources & Research
Manage 3 key resources: Metal, Oil, Cement and build 5 types of structures: Factories, Shipyards, Airfields, Barracks, and Fortifications. Research new technologies to stay one step ahead in the arms race.

📜 National Focuses & 3 Paths to Victory
Your chosen National Focuses will constantly change the geopolitical landscape. Lead your nation to glory through 3 distinct paths: Military Conquest, Global Alliance, or Economic Supremacy.

🏆 Progression & Leaderboards
Prove your skills! Unlock 74 unique achievements, climb the 3 global leaderboards, and customize your player profile with over 150 frames, titles, and ranks. Cross-platform cloud saves are supported!

⚖️ Focus on Fair Play
Victory is achieved through your grand strategy and tactical brilliance, not through forced microtransactions.

Take command, forge the perfect plan, and prove you are the greatest strategist of your time!
data.description_short: Grand WW2 strategy. Command army, navy & air force. Conquer 35 nations!

data.name: Broke to Boss: Idle Tycoon
data.description_full:
Minus one million dollars! That's your starting balance.

The rent is late, the bills hit every day, and the people you let down are keeping their distance.

This is where the comeback begins.

Broke to Boss is an idle tycoon about clawing your way out of debt and building an empire from the bottom. Tap to crack ore into cash. Run small work loops. Buy your first business. Then your tenth. Watch a red, empty screen slowly fill with income, assets, and the life you lost.

WHAT YOU DO
Tap the mining chamber for fast cash, run timed jobs and manual businesses for bigger payouts, then reinvest into businesses that pay you while you're gone. Clear debt milestone by milestone until the balance finally turns positive, and keep climbing.

KEY FEATURES
⛏ Tap mining refinery: Split ore, funnel it down, watch cash particles pile up.
🏢 124 businesses: Buy, upgrade, and automate income across dozens of districts.
💸 Idle & offline earnings: The empire keeps working while you don't.
📈 30 stocks: Buy low, sell high, and grow your portfolio (or blow it up).
🏎 315 status assets: 105 cars, 105 properties, 105 paintings to flex and earn respect.
🗺 34 districts: Climb from the streets to a private spaceport and beyond.
🤝 Win your life back: Money clears debt. Trust rebuilds. Reconnect with the people you lost.
👔 Hire a manager: Automate the grind, pay the bills, and scale hands-free.

PROGRESSION WITH REAL DEPTH
Every dollar matters early, when a single daily bill can wipe you out. Crisis events force real choices. Reputation multiplies your income. Debt milestones pay out as you cross them. The further you climb, the denser your dashboard gets: from one ore tap to a portfolio of businesses, stocks, status, and restored relationships.

THE FANTASY
This isn't about being rich. It's about getting back up. Broke to Boss turns a negative balance into a slow, satisfying machine of recovery: panic replaced by systems, debt replaced by an empire.

Your comeback starts at zero. Actually, it starts below it.

Download Broke to Boss and go from BROKE to BO$$.

誰說稱王一定要累得半死？別人要肝要農，你只需要動動手指，輕輕鬆鬆就能創造骨王傳奇。
登入直接送 10,000 抽，骨碌骨碌隨便抽，每個骨頭都是最強「骨力軍團」

【養骨有妙招：豪禮狂送，助力稱王】
上線即享豪禮狂歡，寶箱遍地開，英靈隨手招，資源輕鬆爆滿倉。自動掛機征戰不打烊，戰力猛猛漲、骷髏不忙碌、不費力亦能稱王。

【召喚有巧思：佛系抽卡，萬骨可養】
全圖鑒收集講究緣分，緣分到來誰也擋不住。抽卡無需繁瑣儀式，不用焚香沐浴、不看時辰風水，指尖輕輕一劃，英靈自動排隊前來歸順。滿倉只是起步，養到會進化才是真正本領！

【變強有捷徑：花式進化，成就骨王】
還在苦研複雜進化路線？我們的養成邏輯簡單直接。輕鬆培養即可快速變強，一路橫掃對手毫無壓力。每隻骷髏都能花式「進化」—— 從灰撲撲小骨頭變成青熒到發光骷髏王，外型與實力雙重飛升，進化之路永無止境～

【陣容有講究：自由搭配，陣陣都強】
他人絞盡腦汁研究陣容，我們的小骷髏只有隨心所欲。戰力擔當、輸出核心、防禦大將隨意組合，流派套路自由切換，無需死抄作業，不被固定玩法束縛。輕鬆搭配即可橫掃戰場，你的戰術你做主，魔界任你馳騁！

【稱王有坦途：從骨到王，輕鬆無壓】
開局只是一隻無人在意的小骷髏，全程佛系養成、花式進化、隨心搭配。輕輕鬆鬆晉升魔界戰神。讓整個魔界都知道 —— 輕鬆是態度，養成才是王道！

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. Không cần hiến tế tài nguyên, không cần đổi chác vận may - càng tu luyện, càng được ưu đãi, để pháp lực thăng hoa và quyền năng ngày một lớn mạnh.

data.description_full:
Looking for a perfect way to unwind and challenge your brain? Welcome to MergeHex: Color Calm, a soothing yet deeply engaging hex-puzzle game designed to melt your stress away! 🧩✨

🎨 Achieve Victory: Reach the target score or clear enough blocks before the entire grid gets filled up to win the level!

Why You Will Love MergeHex:
🧠 Relaxing Yet Strategic Gameplay: No rushing, no frantic timers. Take your time to plan your moves and enjoy a truly peaceful puzzle experience.
✨ Spectacular Chain Reactions: Watch with pure satisfaction as one smart placement triggers multiple color stacks and clears the entire board in beautiful harmony!
🎵 Soothing Audiovisuals: Immerse yourself in clean, minimalist design, elegant color palettes, and a calming ambient soundtrack.
🏆 Levels to Master: Progress through beautifully designed levels that gently scale in complexity, keeping your mind sharp and entertained.

Discover your inner zen and test your puzzle skills at the same time. Download MergeHex: Color Calm today and start your relaxing color-merging journey! ⬡🎨🕊️

data.description_full:

世界中で大人気の原作小説を元に構築した300万文字を超える濃厚なストーリー。

本作だけのオリジナルIFルートを多数実装し、全キャラとデートも可能に！
原作では描かれなかった未知なる可能性を、あなたの手で体験しよう！

▼今なら最大400連分無料ガチャ！ログインだけで全キャラ解放のチャンス！
キャラクターの収集ハードルは低めに設定！
ログインボーナスでは、恒常・限定を問わず多くのキャラクターが入手可能！
イベント報酬も充実！ 魅力的なキャラを仲間に迎え絆を深めよう！

▼セミオート王道RPG×策略×爽快バトル
キャラクターの編成や絆の発動など、あなたの戦略次第でバトルはより楽しく奥深く変化する！
オートプレイモードもあるので、カジュアルにも楽しめる！
キャラクターごとにバトル中の専用演出もあるので、爽快感UP！
策略を駆使して、言霊を放て！

▼デイリーミッションはAIにお任せ！
ゲーム内にはAI助手“ノルマ”を実装。
ボタンひとつで面倒なデイリーミッションなどをAIがオールクリア。キャラ育成も超簡単。
より快適に、より自由に、ストレスフリーで『ドラガク』を楽しめる！

▼世界を広げる豊富なイベントとコンテンツ
バトルやメインストーリー以外にも、数多くのミニゲームやサブストーリーを実装！
月毎にイベントも実装し、さまざまな角度から『ドラガク』の世界をディープに遊びつくそう！

▼豪華なサウンドと演出
テーマ曲《IVORY TOWER》はさまざまなアニメやドラマのサウンドを手掛ける澤野弘之氏が担当。
さらに美麗なキャラクター、迫力あるCG演出、Live2Dによる繊細な動きが、新たな『龍族』の世界へあなたを導きます！
豪華声優陣が続々出演（五十音順）
石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

▼ストーリー
遥か昔、この星は【黒の龍王】ニードホッグを創造した。
そして【黒の龍王】は、【白の龍王】をはじめとするすべての竜の始祖となった。
【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。
その後、【黒の龍王】は四大君主と呼ばれる4対の龍王を創造し、【白の龍王】は人間との間に多くの混血種たちを残した。
世界は竜族を中心に廻っているかのように見えたが……
ある日、【黒の龍王】が暗殺されたことで世界は一変した。
これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.description_full:
Mahjong Crush: Tile Match puts a new spin on the classic: instead of tapping pairs, you slide tiles across the board and match them on collision. It sounds simple — and it is to pick up — but clearing a full board takes real planning.

🀄 Slide to match
Push a tile and watch it glide. When two matching suits meet, they disappear. The satisfying click of a clean collision never gets old.

🧩 Think a few moves ahead
Each slide shifts the whole board. A good move creates a chain; a careless one closes off your options. Levels start approachable and gradually ask more of you — planning a sequence, setting up combos, working around the layout.

🌿 Play at your own pace
No countdown timers. Take your time to read the board, line up the right push, and feel the quiet satisfaction of a well-played level. If you get stuck, hints and shuffle are there when you need them.

✨ Clean visuals, clear tiles
Large, sharp tiles that are easy to read — especially on bigger screens. Smooth animations and subtle feedback on every match, without going overboard.
data.description_short: Slide tiles, match suits, clear the board.

data.name: Idle Truck Fleet
data.description_full:
Build a trucking empire that spans the United States, one dispatch at a time.

Idle Truck Fleet is a transport tycoon where you grow a trucking company from a single van into a coast-to-coast operation. Open a live map of hubs and highways, hire drivers with real personality, and send your fleet rolling along routed paths you can actually watch.

WHAT YOU DO
Pick jobs from a rotating board where cargo type, payout, distance, and client tier all matter. Hire drivers whose traits change speed, pay, and how carefully they handle freight. Buy vans and semis, tap dispatch, and watch your trucks move across the country. Every clean delivery builds your reputation and your bank balance.

KEY FEATURES
• Fleet garage packed with dozens of real-world inspired trucks
• Driver roster with traits that shift speed, pay, and cargo care
• HQ Network: buy hubs to unlock new states and longer routes
• Company levels, reputation stars, and deep upgrade trees
• Research lab, achievements, and mega contracts from major clients
• World events that boost or disrupt the freight market
• Road incidents that put real decisions in your hands
• Diesel Cans to finish a haul early when you want the payout now

PROGRESSION
Start in Chicago with regional loads. Push into new states, unlock premium cargo, and chase a five-star reputation with clean, on-time deliveries. Invest in dispatch speed, negotiation, and marketing to grow a brand that drivers want to work for.

FLEET AI AND ABILITIES
Unlock Dispatch All to send your whole fleet out in a single tap. Stack research bonuses for reefers, hazmat, and fragile freight. React to hurricanes, fuel surges, and market booms that swing payouts on the job board.

IDLE EARNINGS
Your trucks keep rolling while you are away, up to your offline window. Come back to full delivery summaries and stacked earnings, not a thin idle trickle.

PERFECT IF YOU LOVE
Made for fans of idle tycoon games, truck and transport simulators, and business sim or management games. If you like money clicker progression and dispatcher style decisions, this one is your kind of grind: part logistics empire builder, part road trip across America. No racing, no parking, just smart dispatching and a delivery business that grows every time you check in.

Name your company.
Hire your first driver.
Roll your first truck.
The highway is open!
